source.label: Unchanged A512 hard index and teacher kind derived from that existing label; A1024 audit only

model.kindMask: Read-only first three one-hot candidate features; verify against stored legal keys before fit; no key/teacher input to forward

inference.selection: Unchanged raw full-list s argmax, first original index tie; no teacher-kind or balanced-kind routing
inference.probabilities: Global sum-softmax kind mass and auxiliary log-mean-exp kind softmax are different diagnostics; never substitute for actual selection

objective.kind: For present legal kinds g: a[g] = logsumexp(s[G_g]) - log(n_g); L_kind = native cross_entropy(a, target_kind)
objective.point: Disabled; do not evaluate point conditional CE, including on teacher-point observations
objective.normalization: Mean per observation in the actual batch including zero kind terms; final batch uses actual length. No class reweighting, oversampling or separate kind-only denominator
objective.numeric: CPU float32; all CE terms use original torch.nn.functional.cross_entropy, with logsumexp minus log(n_g) for kind logits; mathematical identities do not authorize a differently rounded flat-loss rewrite; full legal mask; finite losses/gradients required
objective.absentKinds: Exclude empty kinds, never log(0). One present kind gives exactly zero extra kind CE and gradient; flat CE remains. Missing target, bad one-hot/key agreement, nonfinite or candidate order drift is STOP.
objective.interpretation: The kind target derives only from the original A512 hard label; no new target enters forward. No target-coordinate-specific extra loss. Shared parameters can still change all predictions; singleton-kind predictions are not invariant to training on other observations.

training.order: Identical cold initialization and explicit train shuffle audit; no pretrained warm start
training.selection: Per arm highest original A512 dev actual top1, earliest epoch tie; no point/oracle/NLL-based reselection
training.baselineControl: Before candidate: reproduce original spatial and both completed flat controls history/shuffle/epoch11/logical weights/full logits/predictions/optimized flat trace exactly. Checkpoint serialization bytes and changed diagnostic-only loss columns need not match. STOP on drift.
training.initialControl: Two fresh same-seed original spatial models, one full-list call each per 428 observations; logits and initial logical weights exact
training.candidateControl: Only kind-only versus concurrent flat is the primary contrast. Combined and point-only archives are historical context; no third/fourth training arm or post-hoc fixed-epoch reselection.

forwardBudget.scope: Only successful approved future run. Count actual calls before each top-level forward, including train/dev and chunk32 graph; no extra warmups/telemetry/common-only calls
forwardBudget.failure: STOP with partial ledger/output preserved; no silent restart, retry or extra epoch/seed/weight sweep

resources.runtime: Existing CPU PyTorch; no new dependencies, install, GPU or service
resources.scope: Owned preflight then baseline then candidate; child timer covers preparation/load/train/eval, total owner timer covers orchestration. RSS samples at load/batch-before-after/eval; not instantaneous peak

screening.decision: Report technical compliance, original all-four-gate screening, kind mechanism and tradeoff guards separately. Mechanism or non-regression PASS cannot replace the original four gates or prove coordinate improvement.
screening.diagnostics: Train/dev actual top1/point/reroll, kind confusion/teacher-point kind recall, oracle top1/top5/rank/NLL, full NLL/errors and fixed subgroup denominators; point both/kind-only/coordinate-only/neither; paired gains/regressions and error transitions vs concurrent control. Report legal-kind singleton groups separately.
screening.historicalCohorts: The two old combined recoveries/regressions and the old point-only regression may be described after freezing only; no special loss weighting, early stopping, oversampling, routing or acceptance selection on those observations.

boundaries.publicVerification: Existing Node stdlib only: proposal schema/evidence hashes and synthetic scalar log-mean-exp/CE/finite-difference checks. No Python/torch/model/checkpoint/logits or real training runner.
boundaries.implementation: Training wrapper/config and FP32 autograd tests are not implemented in this design. Never modify or execute the frozen prior loss runners/configs to simulate this proposal.
boundaries.interpretation: Known-dev single-seed selected-epoch screen. The kind-only-vs-flat protocol difference is primary; historical selected epochs differ. No kind-only evidence yet, fixed-epoch factorial interaction estimate, causal attribution, held-out survival or product superiority.
boundaries.futureExecutionAndPublication: Separate explicit execution decision is required for the new two CPU12epoch/12840-forward run and its results publication; no training or future unconditional push authorized by this design.
